    • 字段详细资料

      • allocateStrategy

        @NameInMap(value="AllocateStrategy")
public String allocateStrategy

        The resource allocation strategy. Valid values: ForceLocal and Optional. You cannot set this parameter to ForceLocal when you downgrade the instance.

        example:

        Optional

      • allowMajorVersionUpgrade

        @NameInMap(value="AllowMajorVersionUpgrade")
public Boolean allowMajorVersionUpgrade

        Specifies whether to perform a major engine version upgrade for the ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Valid values:

        • true: performs the upgrade.
        • false (default): does not perform the upgrade.
        • When you perform a major engine version upgrade, you must also pass the other required parameters, including DBInstanceId, EngineVersion, DBInstanceClass, Category, ZoneId, and VSwitchId.
        • If you want to upgrade the instance to the high availability series or Cluster Edition, you must also specify the ZoneIdSlave1 parameter.
        example:

        false

      • autoUseCoupon

        @NameInMap(value="AutoUseCoupon")
public Boolean autoUseCoupon

        Specifies whether to use vouchers to offset fees. Valid values:

        • true (default): uses vouchers.
        • false: does not use vouchers.
        example:

        true

      • burstingEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="BurstingEnabled")
public Boolean burstingEnabled

        Specifies whether to enable the I/O performance burst feature for premium performance disks. Valid values:

        • true: enables the feature.
        • false: disables the feature.
        example:

        false

      • category

        @NameInMap(value="Category")
public String category

        The instance edition. Valid values:

        This parameter is required when EngineVersion is set to a SQL Server version number.

        Regular ApsaraDB RDS instances
        • Basic: Basic Edition
        • HighAvailability: high availability series
        • AlwaysOn: Cluster Edition (for SQL Server)
        • Cluster: Cluster Edition (for MySQL)
        • <props="china">Finance: Finance Edition
        Serverless ApsaraDB RDS instances (not supported for MariaDB)
        • serverless_basic: Serverless Basic Edition (only for MySQL and PostgreSQL)
        • serverless_standard: Serverless high availability series (only for MySQL and PostgreSQL)
        • serverless_ha: Serverless high availability series (only for SQL Server)
        example:

        HighAvailability

      • coldDataEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="ColdDataEnabled")
public Boolean coldDataEnabled

        Specifies whether to enable the data archiving feature for premium performance disks. Valid values:

        • true: enables the feature.

        • false: disables the feature.

        example:

        true

      • compressionMode

        @NameInMap(value="CompressionMode")
public String compressionMode

        Specifies whether to enable the storage compression feature for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL. Valid values:

        • on: enables the feature.
        • off: disables the feature.
        example:

        on

      • DBInstanceClass

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceClass")
public String DBInstanceClass

        The target instance type. You can call the DescribeAvailableClasses operation to query the available instance types.

        • You must specify at least one of the DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage parameters.
        • You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to view the current instance type.
        example:

        mysql.n8.large.2c

      • DBInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceId")
public String DBInstanceId

        Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        rm-uf6wjk5****

      • DBInstanceStorage

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceStorage")
public Integer DBInstanceStorage

        The target storage capacity. Unit: GB. You can call the DescribeAvailableClasses operation to query the available storage capacity range for the target instance type.

        • You must specify at least one of the DBInstanceStorage and DBInstanceClass parameters.
        • You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to view the current storage capacity of the instance.
        example:

        100

      • DBInstanceStorageType

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceStorageType")
public String DBInstanceStorageType

        The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

        • local_ssd: premium local SSD
        • cloud_ssd: standard SSD (not recommended; no longer available in some regions)
        • cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
        • cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
        • cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
        • general_essd: premium performance disk

        When you change the storage type of the instance, note the following items: <props="china">* If you change the storage type from ESSD to premium performance disk, other parameters such as the instance type and storage capacity must remain unchanged and cannot be modified.

        <props="china">* For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB instances whose storage type is standard SSD, you can set this parameter to cloud_essd to upgrade the storage type to ESSD. To perform the upgrade, you must specify both DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage, and their values must be the same as the current values of the instance.

        <props="china">* For ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade standard SSDs to ESSDs of any PL, but you cannot downgrade ESSDs to standard SSDs.

        <props="intl">For ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade standard SSDs to ESSDs of any PL, but you cannot downgrade ESSDs to standard SSDs.

        example:

        local_ssd

      • dedicatedHostGroupId

        @NameInMap(value="DedicatedHostGroupId")
public String dedicatedHostGroupId

        The ID of the dedicated cluster.

        example:

        dhg-7a9****

      • direction

        @NameInMap(value="Direction")
public String direction

        The type of specification change. Valid values:

        • Up (default): upgrade for subscription instances, and upgrade or downgrade for pay-as-you-go instances.
        • Down: downgrade for subscription instances.
        • TempUpgrade: elastic specification change for subscription ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. This value is required for elastic specification changes.
        • Serverless: elastic setting adjustment for Serverless instances.

        If you only change the DBInstanceStorageType parameter, such as changing standard SSDs to ESSDs, leave this parameter empty.

        example:

        Up

      • effectiveTime

        @NameInMap(value="EffectiveTime")
public String effectiveTime

        The effective period of the new configurations. Valid values:

        Changing some configurations may affect the instance. Read the Impact section in the feature documentation before you configure this parameter. We recommend that you perform the operation during off-peak hours.

        • Immediate (default): The new configurations immediately take effect.
        • MaintainTime: The new configurations take effect within the maintenance window.
        • ScheduleTime: The new configurations take effect at a specified time. The specified time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time. The actual switchover time follows the formula: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime.
        example:

        MaintainTime

      • engineVersion

        @NameInMap(value="EngineVersion")
public String engineVersion

        The database engine version. Valid values:

        Regular ApsaraDB RDS instances
        • MySQL: 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0
        • SQL Server: 2008r2, 08r2_ent_ha, 2012, 2012_ent_ha, 2012_std_ha, 2012_web, 2014_std_ha, 2016_ent_ha, 2016_std_ha, 2016_web, 2017_std_ha, 2017_ent, 2019_std_ha, 2019_ent, 2022_web, 2022_std_ha, 2022_ent, 2025_std, and 2025_ent
        • PostgreSQL: 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, and 15.0
        • MariaDB: 10.3
        Serverless ApsaraDB RDS instances (not supported for MariaDB)
        • MySQL: 5.7 and 8.0
        • SQL Server: 2016_std_sl, 2017_std_sl, and 2019_std_sl
        • PostgreSQL: 14.0, 15.0, and 16.0
        example:

        8.0

      • payType

        @NameInMap(value="PayType")
public String payType

        The current billing method of the instance. Valid values:

        • Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
        • Prepaid: subscription.
        • Serverless (not supported for ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB instances): Serverless.

        To change the billing method to Serverless, you must configure the auto-start and auto-stop (AutoPause), scaling range (MaxCapacity and MinCapacity), and elastic policy (SwitchForce) parameters. For more information, see Overview of Serverless ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances, Overview of Serverless ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances, and Overview of Serverless ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances.

        example:

        Postpaid

      • switchTime

        @NameInMap(value="SwitchTime")
public String switchTime

        The time when the specification change is performed. We recommend that you perform the specification change during off-peak hours.

        Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time).

        • The specified time must be later than the current time (the time when the API call is initiated). Otherwise, the specification change task fails. After the task fails, you must wait for the order to be automatically canceled before you can initiate the call again.
        • If you only increase the storage capacity or change the ESSD storage type, the specification change is performed immediately after submission because it does not affect your business. You do not need to configure this parameter.
        example:

        2019-07-10T13:15:12Z

      • targetMinorVersion

        @NameInMap(value="TargetMinorVersion")
public String targetMinorVersion

        The minor engine version of the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance. When you change the instance type and an error indicating that the minor engine version is not supported is returned, you must specify the minor engine version to upgrade the minor engine version during the instance type change.

        Format: rds_postgres_<Major version number>00_<Minor version number>. Example for version 12 released on August 30, 2020: rds_postgres_1200_20200830.

        example:

        rds_postgres_1200_20200830

      • usedTime

        @NameInMap(value="UsedTime")
public Long usedTime

        The duration of the elastic upgrade for the ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Unit: days.

        example:

        3

      • vSwitchId

        @NameInMap(value="VSwitchId")
public String vSwitchId

        The vSwitch ID. The zone where the vSwitch resides must correspond to the zone ID specified in ZoneId.

        • The network type InstanceNetworkType must be set to VPC.
        • If you specify ZoneSlaveId1 (the secondary zone ID), you must specify two vSwitch IDs and separate them with a comma (,).

          You only need to specify the vSwitch when you upgrade the major engine version of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance (AllowMajorVersionUpgrade), or when you need to set this parameter to switch the vSwitch.

        example:

        vsw-bp1oxflciovg9l7******

      • zoneId

        @NameInMap(value="ZoneId")
public String zoneId

        The zone ID.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou-b

      • zoneIdSlave1

        @NameInMap(value="ZoneIdSlave1")
public String zoneIdSlave1

        The zone ID of the secondary node. If this value is the same as the value of ZoneId, it is a single-zone deployment. If this value is different from the value of ZoneId, it is a multi-zone deployment.

        You only need to specify the secondary zone when you upgrade the major engine version of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance (AllowMajorVersionUpgrade), or when you need to set this parameter to switch the secondary zone.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou-c
